text:
Maya: quick heads-up — I'm briefly owning release note shape checks for today's merge window. Please follow the minimal shape below. I'll ping owners for fixes by 10:45am PT. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Liam: thanks Maya. what's the minimal shape?

Maya: Minimal:
- component tag (comma-separated)
- 1 short sentence (what changed)
- PR link and author
- any user-facing impact (none/optional)

Liam: concise, nice. do we have an automated lint?

Maya: yes — lint exists but it's only structural. it won't check tone. still, it blocks merges for malformed entries.

Sam: can you show a copy-paste example i can drop into my PR?

Maya: sure — paste this single-line template into your release_notes file or PR body:

```
component: short one-line summary. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/#### (author). impact: none/minor/major
```

Alex: example from my PR: `infra: reduce KV cache mem usage — switch to compacted cache. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4123 (Alex). impact: none.`

Daria: if a change touches multiple areas, comma-separate components right?

Maya: yep — e.g., `infra, runtime: ...` keeps it searchable. prefer specificity over `misc`.

release-bot: NOTE-LINT: All notes must pass /tools/release-notes/lint by merge. Failing will block merge.

Alex: if lint fails for formatting, can maintainers auto-fix or do authors need to update?

Maya: small formatting fixes we can push as a follow-up commit but prefer authors update content. the steward will request the edit first.

Liam: owners, please call out if you can't make the edits in time. we can delay merges if needed.

Sam: pinging owners: @Alex @Daria @Miguel — please add/format your note lines if your PRs target today's window.

Alex: will update #4123 in ~20 min.

Daria: updating #4110 now, adding component and short summary.

Miguel: my PR is docs-only, impact: none — will add the line in a minute.

Maya: thanks. I'll do a steward sweep at 10:20 and leave comment threads on PRs that need changes. If you see my comment, please update rather than resolving it for me.

Liam: one more ask — if unsure about component, default to `platform` not `misc`. It's easier for triage later.

Maya: quick note on merge ops: if your PR is blocked by note lint after 10:50, ping me with the PR link and I'll either help reword or hold the merge until fixed.

Alex: noted :thumbsup:

Maya: final reminder — merge window closes at 11:00 PT. After that only urgent hotfixes via oncall and a rollback plan.

release-bot: DEPLOY-WINDOW: merge-window-2026-03-17 closes at 11:00 PT.

Sam: thanks all, will keep an eye on comments.
